title: Love Yourself in 2016
excerpt: LOVE is a concept known by all, but not practiced by everyone. In this world of chaos and stress with work and family, it sometimes limits us in the way we appreciate, nourish and strengthen ourselves.
content:
LOVE is a concept known by all, but not practiced by everyone. In this world of chaos and stress with work and family, it sometimes limits us in the way we appreciate, nourish and strengthen ourselves.  Love is a key component that we should all remember to practice each day: not only toward others, but for ourselves as well.  We all need to take time for ourselves; to be tender, kind and forgiving to ourselves. In this way we make the shift from survive to thrive.

A great way to take time for yourself, and to love yourself, is by participating in one of the Hippocrates Lifestyle weekend workshops.  These workshops provide a nurturing space for self-discovery, personal growth and self-empowerment.

Whether you are seeking to awaken the creative forces within you, find balance and harmony in your life, or manifest your dreams, HHI offers a series of weekend workshops that will be sure to enlighten, open new doors, and bring you closer to realizing your full potential than ever before.

Enjoy one or more of these upcoming engaging, hands- on workshops, and take home the tools and tricks to embrace your new beginning:

  1. A Hands of Light Workshop, February 21, 2016: Learn about the four dimensions of humankind, discover perceiving with High Sense Perception, and practice giving and receiving energetic healings.

  2. Happiness Connection, March 4, 5, and 6, 2016: This transformational 3 day workshop offers a gentle, effective way to bring happiness to your life. Release patterns of self-sabotage; remove your road blocks to Happiness; and reclaim your Personal Power.

  3. Create Quantum Miracles by Letting Go, March 12, 2016: Rewire your brain for Health, Happiness and Prosperity. Learn how to do tapping with Heartmath.  Release old traumas and blockages to get you energy flowing. Manifest the Life of your Dreams!

  4. Essential Oils Workshop, April 17, 2016: Explore how you can use essential oils every day for optimal health; learn proven remedies for common ailments; create your own products to take home and use.

  5. Creative Writing Workshop, Level 1, May 14, 2016:  Awaken the creative forces within you!  Discuss your passion and purpose; organize and categorize topics; develop intention, invention and imagination; and produce a plan for you book project.
